Certainly! Here are two hints for the given problem:

**Hint 1:**
To determine if a set of columns is linearly independent, consider whether any column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others. If no column can be expressed this way, the set is linearly independent.

**Hint 2:**
Remember that the span of a set of vectors (or columns, in this case) is the set of all possible linear combinations of those vectors. To have the same span as the original columns, the new set must be able to represent any vector that the original set could. Consider how the conversion between metric and imperial units might affect linear independence and span.
